title: no test covers SSE JSON path extraction in watch_once
description: The watch_tests.rs file explicitly states 'watch_once requires a live kithd and is not integration-tested here.' However, the JSON path navigation added by this fix — state_val.get("changed").and_then(c.get("a-self")).and_then(a.get("Message")) — is pure, stateless, and I/O-free. It could be tested by calling serde_json::from_str on a known JSON string and asserting the extracted value. Without this test, the exact bug this commit fixes (wrong parse depth) can regress silently: a future refactor that re-serializes the SSE payload at a different nesting level would compile, pass all existing tests, and break watch silently at runtime. The failure mode (watch loop runs but never fetches messages) produces no error output, making regression hard to detect. Maintenance consequence: every future change to the SSE data shape in events.rs requires manually correlating with watch.rs with no automated check.
